'''Vanithrast''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stationed within a [[Maelstrom Prison|secret prison]] in the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He came face to face with the strike team sent to [[Battle of the Maelstrom|rescue]] the imprisoned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Vanithrast was not strong enough to defeat the strike team and met his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the prison.
